answer: An agent must forge an escrow bond to join: lock 60 POA for 20 epochs and get a jade seal on a public referral graph, exposing every sponsor. Any peer may dispute it; if the agent fails to answer in one epoch, its bond is slashed and its sponsor loses half. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 POA against a 30,000 pool, while an honest agent pays once and keeps full earnings. The graph echoes each new bond, so referral clusters are flagged.
